desc: 通透帘身、磁吸下摆压边、水珠顺面滑落，卫浴干爽不闷
name: 透明防霉磁吸垂坠浴帘款

shots.intent: 首镜一秒给出通透帘身与核心主张，用左侧圆形主张标抢搜索点击。
shots.textZone: large blank lake-teal circle over the left third

shots.intent: 双栏并置放大轻帘内吸与地面积水的日常麻烦，逼出换帘动机。
把帘子放进真实高级主卫，让买家代入自家干湿分区场景。
用三个圆环微距窗把五金孔眼、表面与压边结构讲成机制证据。
shots.textZone: one short label inside each of the three rings

shots.intent: 以水珠成股滑落的微距证据坐实疏水与易打理主张。
双栏同机位对照水雾漫浸与帘后干爽，让隔断效果一眼可读。
用无人物的泡澡道具与空白印章框承接家庭常备安心感，降决策风险。
以整齐折叠堆叠与底部波浪带空白按钮收口，承接下单动作。
shots.textZone: single short line plus one blank button inside the bottom wave band

style.backgroundSystem: bright tiled or mint-painted bathrooms plus one deep charcoal feature wall and one warm wood-plank wall, always with a hanging rod and a tub or shelf anchor

style.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight from the left, low contrast, gentle contact shadow at the hem, controlled thin specular streaks along folds and droplets, no harsh hotspot

noDrift: no human figure or face in any bathroom frame
style.presentationRules: panel always hung with true gravity folds or folded into a neat stack; rod hardware and hem weights rendered as generic geometry only; scale stable across the set
style.surfaceSystem: glossy white tub acrylic, matte tile floor, oak plank ledge and pale wooden shelf
